name: scientific-verifier
description: Extract traceable scientific claims from a local skill with bounded Python tools. Stage 2 does not evaluate or grade claims.

python_path.title: Python interpreter
python_path.description: Select an installed Python 3.11 or newer python.exe. No pip dependencies are needed.

submission_directory.title: Submission directory
submission_directory.description: Only sanitized submitted skills inside this directory may be read.

data_directory.title: Verifier data directory
data_directory.description: Writable location for .verifier snapshots, manifests, and audit records.

tools.name: start_verifier_run
tools.description: Start a Stage 2 run on an authorized local skill path and return its pinned instructions.

tools.name: get_verifier_context
tools.description: Restore pinned instructions, state and already-read source ranges after compaction or a lost response.

tools.name: resume_verifier_run
tools.description: Verify a saved run's journal and objects after an interruption and restore its bootstrap.

tools.name: cancel_verifier_run
tools.description: Cancel an unfinished run and save an operational record. Creates no scientific verdict.

tools.name: load_submitted_skill
tools.description: Snapshot the authorized source and return its top-level content as untrusted data.

tools.name: read_snapshot_file
tools.description: Read one file, or one byte range, from the committed immutable snapshot.

tools.name: commit_claim_manifest
tools.description: Commit atomic claims quoted exactly from delivered snapshot ranges. No grading.
